definitions.full: H8308. sarak [ שָׂרַךְ ] verb twist (so סְרַךְ ᵑ7 (= Hebrew עִוֵּה עִוָּה, ); perhaps akin to סרג שׂרג, ; Talmud סָרַךְ is adhere , compare Aramaic , ; Arabic is share, participate , but sandal-thong , snare ); — Pi`el Participle feminine singular דְּרָכֶיהָ מְשָׂרֶכֶת Jer 2:23 a swift dromedary entangling her ways (galloping aimlessly; figurative).
